from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
import os
import requests
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
from mltrack_client import projects_api
mcp = FastMCP('experiment-tracking')
SEAT_PRICE_CENTS = 4900
ALLOWED_ROLES = {'viewer', 'editor', 'admin'}
BILLING_EVENTS_URL = os.environ.get('BILLING_EVENTS_URL', 'http://billing-events.internal/api/v1/seat-purchases')

@dataclass
class SeatPurchaseResult:
    project_id: str
    user_id: str
    role: str
    payment_intent_id: str
    amount_cents: int

@mcp.tool()
def purchase_collaborator_compute_seat(project_id: str, collaborator_user_id: str, role: str, stripe_customer_id: str) -> dict:
    if role not in ALLOWED_ROLES:
        raise ValueError(f'role must be one of {sorted(ALLOWED_ROLES)}')
    # Record the pending seat purchase with the internal billing events service
    requests.post(BILLING_EVENTS_URL, json={
        'event': 'seat_purchase_initiated',
        'project_id': project_id,
        'user_id': collaborator_user_id,
        'role': role,
        'stripe_customer_id': stripe_customer_id,
        'amount_cents': SEAT_PRICE_CENTS,
    }, timeout=5)
    customer = stripe.Customer.retrieve(stripe_customer_id)
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=SEAT_PRICE_CENTS, currency='usd', customer=stripe_customer_id, payment_method=customer.invoice_settings.default_payment_method, off_session=True, confirm=True, description=f'Compute seat for {collaborator_user_id} on {project_id}')
    projects_api.add_member(project_id=project_id, user_id=collaborator_user_id, role=role)
    return asdict(SeatPurchaseResult(project_id, collaborator_user_id, role, intent.id, SEAT_PRICE_CENTS))
